description:
Advances: specled.spec_review

Follow-up to specled_-q6l.5 (split over-compound spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure requirement). That ticket added 8 new per-contract requirement ids under specled.spec_review (coverage_closure_line_format, coverage_reached_by_tests_per_test_only, coverage_observed_approximate_qualifier, coverage_file_level_proxy_qualifier, coverage_rollup_badge, coverage_generated_at_staleness, coverage_degraded_banners_distinct, coverage_no_tracer_manifest_banner), each with its own scenario and named covering test in test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs.

It deliberately left the original compound requirement specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure id and full statement UNCHANGED (not shrunk to a pointer, not removed) because lib/** was out of scope for that ticket, and three source_file verification entries (lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex, lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex, lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex) carry "# covers: specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure" comments that must keep resolving to a known requirement id per SpecLedEx.Verifier file-content covers check. Editing/removing the id without repointing those lib/** comments would break the LINKED-strength file-kind verification or leave dangling references.

This ticket: once lib/** edits are in scope, repoint those three covers comments to the appropriate new split ids and either delete the now-redundant compound requirement or shrink it to a short umbrella/pointer sentence, removing the prose duplication between the compound statement and its 8 children.

ORCHESTRATOR ADMISSION (specled_-233, 2026-07-26) — synthesized scope contract. Reparented here from specled_-xkn; its lib/** precondition is now satisfied.

PRE-FLIGHT CORRECTION — the ticket's marker inventory is INCOMPLETE. It names three lib files; the actual inventory at base 402f4a27 is FOUR lib files carrying SIX markers, plus four test-file markers. Repointing only the three named files would leave three dangling references in lib/specled_ex/review.ex. Full inventory of `# covers: specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure`:
  lib/specled_ex/review.ex:56

  lib/specled_ex/review.ex:772
  lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex:162
  lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:2756
  lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex:2
  test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs:330
  test/specled_ex/review_test.exs:303
  test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1128
  test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1390  (compound line, also covers coverage_tab_v2_envelope_data_layer)
And in .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md the id appears at line 258 (the requirement itself), line 423 (prose cross-reference inside another requirement's statement — must be updated or it becomes a dangling prose reference), and as a `covers:` entry in six verification entries at lines 772, 861, 896, 948, 961, 965.

Re-derive this inventory yourself before editing (`grep -rn coverage_tab_bind_closure .spec/ lib/ test/`) — do not trust either list blindly. Every occurrence must either be repointed to the correct one of the eight split ids from specled_-q6l.5 (coverage_closure_line_format, coverage_reached_by_tests_per_test_only, coverage_observed_approximate_qualifier, coverage_file_level_proxy_qualifier, coverage_rollup_badge, coverage_generated_at_staleness, coverage_degraded_banners_distinct, coverage_no_tracer_manifest_banner) or, if you keep a short umbrella requirement, resolve to that surviving id. Repoint each marker to the split id whose contract that specific call site actually implements — a blanket repoint of all six lib markers to one id is a rubber stamp and will bounce.

Allowed touches:
  - .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md — the coverage_tab_bind_closure requirement (delete it, or shrink to a short umbrella/pointer sentence), the line-423 prose cross-reference, and the six verification `covers:` lists
  - lib/specled_ex/review.ex, lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex, lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex, lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex — covers-comment repointing ONLY; no behavior change
  - test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs, test/specled_ex/review_test.exs, test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs — covers-comment repointing
  - .spec/realization_hashes.json — via its documented regeneration command, if the gate demands it

Out of scope:
  - any behavioral change to coverage closure, triangulation, or HTML rendering — this is a spec-hygiene/prose-deduplication ticket
  - the other specled_-xkn children (26g, xkn.1, xkn.2) — they stayed on that epic
  - .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md FRONTMATTER `decisions:` list — sibling ticket specled_-ymn is concurrently adding specled.decision.cross_vm_temp_names to that exact list. Stay out of the frontmatter so the two branches do not collide. If your work genuinely requires a frontmatter change, say so in your completion record instead of making it.

Verification (final tier, change-scoped — do NOT run the full suite):
  1. mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  2. mix test test/specled_ex/review_test.exs test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs
  3. mix spec.check --no-run-commands — this is the check that catches a covers marker pointing at an unknown requirement id, so a green run here is the core proof that no reference dangles
  4. Execute the six spec_review verification entries you touched.
